senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of שֶׁבֶר II)to buy provisions.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:6">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>אף</he> … <he>לִשְׁבָּר אוכל</he> Joseph, too, knew that his brothers were coming down to Egypt to buy food; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:6">ib.</cite> <he>כל מי שנכנס לִשְׁבּוֹר וכ׳</he> let whomsoever enters (Egypt) to buy food register his name &c; Tanḥ. Mikk. 8.

senses.gloss: to sell provisions, to supply. Ib. (ref. to מַשְׁבִּיר, Prov. XI, 26) זה יוסף שזן וכ׳ that means Joseph who sustained the world &c.; Gen. R. l. c.; a. e.—[Tanḥ. ed. Bub. Vayesheb 13 משביר אותו, read: מַשְׂכִּיר.]
